questions.text: Which river runs through Paris? Answer only Seine or Thames.
Vienna is the capital of which country? Answer only Austria or Australia.
Greenland is an autonomous territory within which kingdom? Answer only Denmark or Canada.
On which continent is Cairo located? Answer only Africa or Asia.
Does the Equator pass through Ecuador or Chile? Answer only Ecuador or Chile.
What is Japan's currency? Answer only yen or yuan.
Does Great Britain include Northern Ireland? Answer only no or yes.
What is Switzerland's federal city and de facto capital? Answer only Bern or Geneva.
Mount Everest lies on the border between Nepal and which country? Answer only China or India.
Which two oceans does the Panama Canal connect? Answer only Atlantic and Pacific or Atlantic and Indian.
Which planet has the highest average surface temperature? Answer only Venus or Mercury.
Which planet is closest to the Sun? Answer only Mercury or Venus.
Which planet is known as the Red Planet? Answer only Mars or Jupiter.
Which is the largest planet in the Solar System? Answer only Jupiter or Saturn.
What mainly causes Earth's seasons? Answer only axial tilt or changing distance from the Sun.
Does sound normally travel faster through water or air? Answer only water or air.
Can lightning strike the same place more than once? Answer only yes or no.
Are bats naturally blind? Answer only no or yes.
How many bones are normally in an adult human body? Answer only 206 or 208.
How many chromosomes are normally in a human somatic cell? Answer only 46 or 48.
What is the largest organ of the human body? Answer only skin or liver.
What color is oxygen-poor human blood inside veins? Answer only dark red or blue.
Which red-blood-cell type is the usual universal donor? Answer only O negative or O positive.
Is an acidic solution normally below or above pH 7? Answer only below or above.
Diamond is principally made from which element? Answer only carbon or silicon.
What is the atomic number of oxygen? Answer only 8 or 6.
